verdict.rationale: Kick's MCP/CLI docs explicitly promise agents can 'query your client data in plain language, automate month-end checks' (kick-docs-15) and read/report on live data via Google Sheets AI integrations (kick-docs-2, kick-supp-sheets-ai), while reconciliation docs describe checking for duplicate/missing transactions before close (kick-supp-reconciliation) and an audit trail logs AI actions (kick-supp-audit-trail). However, there is no documented feature that specifically flags spend anomalies or duplicate transactions automatically via an agent — this would require building a custom workflow on top of MCP rather than a shipped anomaly-detection capability. Missing for 10: a native anomaly/duplicate-detection agent feature, evidence of automated alerts pre-close, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow working in practice.
